title: HeyGen pricing in 2026: every plan, credit and real cost

facts.fact: Per this vendor-authored comparison page (Vuela.ai), HeyGen's Free plan costs $0.
Per this page, HeyGen's Creator plan costs $29 per month.
Per this page, HeyGen's Pro plan costs $49 per month.
Per this page, HeyGen's Business plan costs $149 per month.
Per this page, HeyGen's Enterprise plan is priced on request rather than published.
Per this page, extra seats on HeyGen's Business plan cost $20 each per month.
facts.quote: Extra seats on Business are $20 each per month.

facts.fact: Per this page, HeyGen's free plan allows 3 videos per month of up to 1 minute each, with a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 3 videos a month of up to 1 minute, with a watermark.

facts.fact: Per this page, HeyGen's Creator plan includes 600 credits per month.
Per this page, HeyGen's Pro plan includes 1,000 credits per month.
Per this page, HeyGen's Business plan includes 1,500 credits per month.
Per this page, watermark removal on HeyGen starts with the Creator plan and is not available on the free plan.
Per this page, HeyGen's Business plan allows videos up to 60 minutes long.
Per this page, HeyGen's Creator and Pro plans cap individual videos at 30 minutes.
Per this page, HeyGen's free plan includes 1 custom video avatar.
Per this page, HeyGen's Business plan includes 5 custom video avatars.
Per this page, HeyGen prices its API separately from its subscription plans, so API usage is not covered by Creator, Pro or Business credits.
facts.quote: HeyGen prices its API separately from the subscription plans

facts.fact: Per this page, HeyGen's Pro plan costs $20 more than Creator and adds 400 credits (1,000 versus 600).
facts.quote: Pro costs $20 more and adds 400 extra credits (1,000 vs 600)

facts.fact: The page states that HeyGen prices are in USD as taken from heygen.com in September 2026, and that HeyGen can change them at any time.
facts.quote: Prices in USD, taken from heygen.com in September 2026.
